races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside position advantageous around left-handed bends

verdict.comment: The veteran MOSTAWAA is taken to enhance his fine record at this meeting by beating the in-form pair of Hartswood and Epidavros.

comments.alrufaa: Three wins on turf, one on soft; 4th in the Bell here in 2024; best efforts since on AW
comments.barley: Won this off 6lb lower in 2024; handles soft ground; good run latest; interesting
comments.boydouglas: Both wins over 1m at Ayr, the first on heavy; out of form in 2025; stable in better form
comments.epidavros: C&D winner on soft in 2024; in decent form this term (2nd at Hamilton last time); chance
comments.feeltheneed: Off the mark for 2025 at York last time (7f); stays 1m; a possible off 4lb higher
comments.hartswood: In good form; won 3 of last 4 races, and a charity event 12 days ago; goes on soft; chance
comments.havanaprince: In good form, winning 2 of last 3 races, latest over 8.5f; career-high mark; interesting
comments.hotcash: Debut winner in 2024; close 2nd off 3lb lower at Haydock latest; unexposed; chance
comments.impartiality: 3-3 since being gelded; 9lb higher than last win and below par only run on soft
comments.jimmyspeaking: Both wins at 6f although fair third over 1m latest; this looks stronger; others preferred
comments.lightspeed: 7.5f winner last term; fair fourth at Beverley latest and looks to be coming back to form
comments.makeen: Soft-ground winner last term; two creditable runs this season and has an each-way chance
comments.mostawaa: Exposed; won the Bell here in 2023 and third in it last year; conditions ideal; contender
comments.mysteryofthesands: Bidding for third win of 2025 having scored at Beverley and Nottingham; each-way chance
comments.pisanello: Below par since good reappearance run; decent mark, goes on the ground and a possible
comments.telered: Not won since October 2023; conditions suit and fair fourth at York two runs back
comments.yermanthere: Won over 7f here in 2024; now 4lb lower; creditable runs the last twice; quite interesting

races.raceComment: hotcash is marginally preferred with a score of 59.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over epidavros. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 2/6 at carlisle. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form and positive comments and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Jack Channon is in excellent form and recent Goodwood runner-up ARKHALIA FLYNN is taken to go one better. Candonomore is feared.

comments.arkhaliaflynn: Runner-up at Goodwood recently and the forecast slow ground is in his favour
comments.beraz: On a reduced mark but has never run over a trip this short; couple of questions to answer
comments.candonomore: Two 1m wins to kick off campaign and could benefit from the drop back in trip; considered
comments.capitalguarantee: Shaped when fair fifth over 1m1f at York as though this drop back in trip would be a plus
comments.crackshot: Has failed to kick on from promising reappearance third but drops back down in grade today
comments.dainmanutin: Flopped at Musselburgh in April last time but progressive previously and could bounce back
comments.glamsquad: His progress has stalled this season but he may yet be capable of better
comments.goodmorningalex: Dead-heated for first at Ripon in April and had an excuse at Newmarket subsequently
comments.hiromichi: On a handy mark but hasn't shone on either outing this season and has something to prove
comments.liamartydreams: Big step back in right direction when second at Leicester last time; could be in shake-up
comments.lookbacksmiling: On a dangerous mark but there was no return to form on reappearance in March; off since
comments.mrking: A shade underwhelming this season but drops back down in grade off a dangerous mark
comments.navagio: His mark has fallen & he could be a contender with the forecast slow ground in his favour
comments.ontheriver: Four wins last year and good second on reappearance but three lesser runs have followed
comments.redarna: 11yo; has to better this season's two performances but not ruled out off last winning mark
comments.sailthisshipalone: Well treated on form as recent as last August but something to prove on subsequent efforts
comments.urbansprawl: Won at Lingfield last month but below best on both runs since; needs something extra

races.raceComment: ontheriver is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The drop back to 7f could see BLUFFERONTHEBUS atone for two near misses last week. Who Wants Me may prove best of the rest.

comments.beronia: Of interest on her best form and seems to handle most ground; not ruled out
comments.blufferonthebus: Two near misses off this mark last week; leading contender back at 7f
comments.irisdancer: Thriving mare; well in under a penalty but 0-9 over 7f and others may see it out better
comments.liberalised: Well held on handicap debut last month; dropped 4lb but wouldn't want much more rain
comments.magnagreciastar: Not beaten far at Chester latest; this stiffer test should suit; not yet fully exposed
comments.orangesandlemons: One win and five 2nds from 6 starts; good run here (1m) on h'cap debut; should be involved
comments.rosemarymay: Finished last in two handicap runs since her Ayr maiden win; hard to recommend for now
comments.shiningpearl: Runner-up four times but unplaced in both handicaps; edging down weights but needs more
comments.whowantsme: Went down fighting over C&D last week; solid claims off the same mark

races.raceComment: blufferonthebus is marginally preferred with a score of 53.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form over irisdancer. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Top of the list is GOT GREY, who looks interesting on his best hurdling form this year and should have a future at this new discipline.

comments.solidfuel: Hard to predict but he won over C&D last June and was third here last week; not out of it

verdict.comment: This should suit Charm Park point winner CARRIGLUX better than Cartmel.  A suitably rested Prince Cleni may give him most to do.

comments.calvic: Winner here a year ago at 2m4f and still to convince fully over further; blinkers go on.
comments.carriglux: Better judged on Charm Park point win than subsequent Cartmel toil; of great interest.
comments.deadlymissile: Second in this race two years ago; small step back in the right direction latest.
comments.emberscombe: Dual pointing winner on Exmoor at this time of year; needs to upgrade rules efforts.
comments.illicodubreuil: Endured a rough chasing debut latest; has work to do from 5lb out of the handicap.
comments.invictusallen: Uttoxeter winner on soft last July (3m2f); unseen since October's Hereford flop.
comments.mcgregorscharge: Jumped and hung right over 2m4f here latest; player on earlier staying-chase seconds.
comments.micronormous: Back below a winning mark; pulled up on both starts since her latest wind operation.
comments.mistertommyshelby: Late faller over hurdles last time; can win a small race but jumping concerns persist.
comments.mozzaro: Pulled up early on sole run since 2021-22 hat-trick; can only be watched right now.
comments.noblecave: Bled on chase debut last autumn; hung right throughout and didn't see out 3m latest.
comments.prideofparis: Went very close at Uttoxeter last month but bled from the nose latest; stable debut.
comments.princecleni: 3-4 at Southwell and could have something to offer here if the break's done him good.
comments.schoolforscandal: All wins going right-handed, but can function this way round, too; patchy form lately.
comments.watchoutitscookie: Not easily predicted, but chase win did come around a galloping left-hander (Newcastle).

verdict.comment: The vote goes to LUSSO MILAN (nap), who finished a clear second at Stratford last month behind a subsequent winner.

comments.brindley: 0-6 over hurdles but he kept on for second at Southwell latest and is not ruled out
comments.buxtedreel: Unexposed over hurdles and he rallied well when fourth at Market Rasen latest; dangerous
comments.charlottesquare: Has struggled over hurdles and is a long way out of the weights again; can only be watched
comments.inittogether: 0-12 over hurdles but was a good second over C&D last week; respected off same mark
comments.lussomilan: Clear second at Stratford and that was behind a subsequent winner; interesting contender
comments.rukaana: Did well to finish second at Market Rasen but he flopped at Warwick latest; mixed messages
comments.shabano: Lightly raced in recent years and pulled up at 100-1 on handicap hurdle debut in February
comments.smartcasual: Fell over fences last time and now returns to hurdling; would appeal more on slower ground

races.raceComment: inittogether is confidently preferred with a score of 50.9%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over brindley. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 16 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The back-to-form MY BOBBY'S LASS can weave through the field late on to complete a Worcester double, ahead of Robber's Bridge.

comments.alrightdai: Two wins around Christmas on softer than good; came up some way short on hat-trick bid.
comments.barelyfamous: Defied higher marks in 2021-22 on sound surfaces; some fair seconds in points lately.
comments.boskillborden: Drop back from stayers' trip should suit and mark fine; no certainty he'll take to visor.
comments.cloverpass: Twice second in the spring; below par without a hood latest and it's off today also.
comments.ikigaistar: Form of Huntingdon win (2m3f, good) last time has been franked repeatedly; up just 3lb.
comments.justchasingmay: Good runs in defeat since June 2024 win off 17lb lower; absence not necessarily a concern.
comments.kintaro: Best RPRs were recorded over 2m here; two backward steps since April's seller third.
comments.mactavish: Made virtually all to take this race off 3lb lower in 2024; stopped quickly last time out.
comments.masterdancer: RPRs in decline again since his April return; work for the returning cheekpieces to do.
comments.misskassiopi: Headed very late on at Stratford two runs ago (2m3f); cheekpieces less effective latest.
comments.mryeats: Just small late gains when 15l fourth at Market Rasen latest (2m5f, good); down in grade.
comments.mybobbyslass: Enjoyed passing horses late in taking a mares' handicap here latest (2m5f, good); up 6lb.
comments.outbackfrontiers: 3lb below winning mark; out of sorts over hurdles and fences when last seen in December.

verdict.comment: FAIYUM is potential-laden and has won impressively in her two starts. She looks as though the step up in trip here will suit her

comments.andsotobed: Close behind Whirl in Group 3 last year; back to form with tight second last time; chance
comments.barnavara: Experienced 3yo stayed on to take Listed contest last time; step up in trip looks positive
comments.bellacanta: Steadily improved over three runs to land a 1m2f maiden last time; more improvement needed
comments.bonniemoon: French heavy ground maiden winner last time; drop in trip and good ground is of concern
comments.butterflywings: Well beaten in Listed and Group 3 company recently; won her maiden at this trip
comments.calrissiana: Beaten 14l by Faiyum at this track in March; maiden winner here in May; others preferred
comments.darzina: Winner of her sole start at Gowran last month; unknown quantity who is on the shortlist
comments.dawnspirit: Improved to win a maiden at this trip in May; last of nine in Listed company recently
comments.faiyum: Exciting filly who is two from two; evidence of stamina in her two wins so 1m2f seems fine
comments.medicivenus: 2yo Listowel winner; three okay runs this term before well beaten in Group 3 last time
comments.tamamdesert: Galway maiden winner; didn't get clear run over C&D in May; out of depth in 1,000 Guineas

races.raceComment: barnavara is marginally preferred with a score of 50.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more reliable profile over faiyum. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include superior ratings and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Plenty of ifs and buts in this field but UMBRIA likes it here and her Goodwood run last time was probably better than it reads.

comments.crystalmariner: Good effort only start here; no show on turf last time but can likely do better back on AW
comments.donsimon: Moderate on turf last time but better on AW previously; return to this surface may suit
comments.federated: Needs to bounce back but was previously in good form; has won twice over 1m4f here
comments.forcatimao: Up 7lb for a Southwell win and struggled last time; drawn widest off the same mark
comments.kingkeer: Won on reappearance but flopped next time; blinkers go on for this AW debut
comments.lillylux: Two 1m4f AW wins in France; tailed off on stable debut but can surely do better
comments.outgun: Poor after winning here (1m4f) in September but latest over 1m was better; cheekpieces now
comments.sanitiser: Off 181 days; best form for this yard came at Epsom last August; probably best watched
comments.tipsytiger: Might have needed his comeback and ran respectably on his only start here; not impossible
comments.trojanstorm: Won his second handicap and ran respectably last time; likely capable of better; player
comments.umbria: Best form here and her latest run was likely better than it reads; could be the answer
comments.wonder: Not great the last twice but in better races than this; not ruled out back down in trip
comments.xiomara: Yet really to get going for this yard but the handicapper's relenting; worth a second look
comments.zoffandia: Won here (1m) in February but looked very hard work last time; tongue tied now; up in trip

races.raceComment: outgun is marginally preferred with a score of 51.7%, holding clear edges in more progressive over federated. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard To Slow ground from 3 attempts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.goingagain: Showed speed in two starts but hung left over C&D 19 days ago; better is needed

verdict.comment: Galactic Glow and Blue Hero can go well but LAUNCESTON potentially has a ton of improvement in him now handicapping up in trip.

comments.bluehero: All eight wins have come here, two at this trip and three on firm; key player once again
comments.galacticglow: Recent knocks at the door are getting louder; beaten just a neck last time; big shout
comments.ladypacksapunch: 1-40 but the win did come here (11.5f, firm); latest can be forgiven and her mark is fine
comments.launceston: Took five runs to get qualified; will probably take off now handicapping over further
comments.splitsilk: Regressive form in handicaps this year and now blinkers are given a whirl; risky
comments.villalobos: Dropped 2lb after latest run and was in good form here previously; can't be ruled out

races.raceComment: bluehero is marginally preferred with a score of 51.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over villalobos. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Firm) looks ideal with 7 wins from 28 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
